authorization: User: one final training submission, then one separate evaluation-only job. No additional training, no job resubmission.

training.layout: One launcher rank per node; five independent tile-isolated workers on node0 and four on node1. ZE_FLAT_DEVICE_HIERARCHY=FLAT, each worker sees xpu:0.

evaluation.starts_after: training job terminal and per-chain exact continuation gates checked
evaluation.layout: After final training: node0 evaluates case14 first, then case30/case57; node1 evaluates case118. Four origin shards per checkpoint; memory-heavy mixture shards run sequentially per node.

training.recipe: Unchanged v4 data law0.80-1.00, lambda1, K8, B1, fp32, OFF, AdamW, frozen differentiable GENCO
training.noise: Continue every saved Python/NumPy/CPU/XPU RNG state; no reseeding or reset of order, optimizer, counters or patience

lineage.policy: New child run identity and manifest. Read-only parent checkpoints and manifests. Explicit authorized budget extension; only metadata changes in a new child checkpoint.
lineage.checks: Validate exact parent manifest against unchanged parent config/source; hash all non-manifest state before and after new checkpoint serialization; unchanged initialization then standard exact restoration audit before first optimizer update.

gate.justification: No numerical implementation changes; continuation transfers identical serialized state. Final ES is descriptive; no model adoption threshold is added.
gate.failure_policy: No training retry. Failed chain is excluded from dependent evaluation/mixtures and reported; independent valid chains can still be evaluated.

priority: case14 seed5 and full eight-seed mixture
evaluation.noise_convention: 10042+global origin index, existing frozen scorer and evaluation kernels ON
evaluation.baseline_policy: Reuse C/P/P0/S and same-input P/Ipopt audits from frozen grid-specific evaluations
evaluation.membership: Fixed prefixes0..m-1; all seeds equally weighted; every cross-seed pair rescored jointly; no score-based inclusion. Existing1/2/3 curves referenced. Five/eight use final authorized budget-capped checkpoints even without early stopping and are labeled accordingly.
evaluation.incomplete: Report missing cells; no new job beyond the one evaluation allocation
evaluation.statistical_policy: Descriptive single-seed and empirical mixture results; shared fixed evaluation noise disclosed; no new inference/adoption gate

finalization: Defer existing final merge/tag until both authorized jobs terminate; preserve original19:00 freeze artifacts and original repository staged/dirty edits.
